The '''Anq-Y enhanced optics suite''' was a model of [[Enhanced optics suite/Legends|enhanced optics suite]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement added to the user's helmet, it increased the user's awareness of their surroundings through the inclusion of a number of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The system was manufactured by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] and sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Anq-Y enhanced optics suite was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
